design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value for analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study mentions a two-stage sampling design but does not explicitly state whether sampling weights were applied in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without accounting for school clustering, as there is no mention of multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and only discusses internal validation strategies.
